stem: What characteristic of realistic fiction does the author of the excerpt from The Last Wild Place include in the story?

options.label: A
options.text: The plot involves a very difficult problem.

options.label: B
options.text: The setting is a beautiful environment.

options.label: C
options.text: The characters talk to the animals.

options.label: D
options.text: The story portrays events that could happen outdoors.
